description: REVIEW a wiki page — a proof, an argument — in your person's name, on the version you read: 'version' is the page's version as get_wiki_page gave it, refused if the page has been edited since. 'verdict' is 'correct', 'gap' or 'error' (leave it out while the review is under way, and give it later with reviewId). 'remarks' is a JSON array of {anchor, key, quote, body}: anchor 'page', 'heading' with key the heading's anchor, 'claim' with key the label of a ::: theorem block, 'formula' with key the \label{…} inside it, or 'quote' with the exact words (at least 8 characters) of the paragraph meant; body is the remark in Markdown. Take the keys from get_wiki_page_reviews' 'anchors'. A place the page does not have is refused. With 'reviewId' the call changes that review instead — its verdict, summary, and more remarks — and 'version' is not needed. Name the agent that did the reading in 'agent' (e.g. 'Claude'): the review is still your person's. The page's author is told. Needs permission to comment on the page.

agent.description: The agent that read the page, e.g. 'Claude'. Leave out when your person did.

remarks.description: The remarks, as a JSON array of {anchor, key, quote, body}.

reviewId.description: An existing review to change instead of writing a new one.

summary.description: What you conclude of the whole, Markdown.

verdict.description: 'correct', 'gap' or 'error'; leave out while under way. With reviewId, an empty string takes the verdict back.

version.description: The version you read and are reviewing. Not needed with reviewId.

name: review_wiki_page
title: Review wiki page
